description: H10 reviewed answer-quality contract, authored before scoring. Gold answers are hand-adjudicated propositions, not provider outputs. Snapshot arithmetic and explicitly stated geography conventions are not independent certification of current facts. Captured/supplied plans establish only deterministic semantics, never live end-to-end accuracy.

review.method: Author review against the original whole question, explicit convention and frozen fixture. No live providers or production/player rows used.
review.effective_date_policy: Unknown dates/citations remain unknown. Historical NATO labels require independent evidence review before live release approval.

split_policy.unit: semantic family; EN/PL paraphrases and target variants remain in one split
split_policy.development: Known regression families available for tuning.
split_policy.held_out: Prospective evaluation families unavailable for prompt tuning. Existing fixture exposure means this is a proposed release split, not proof of an uncontaminated external benchmark. Once results guide a fix, retire those families to development and author a fresh held-out set before approval.

release_policy.claim: Corpus-scoped release guard, not population accuracy or universal correctness.

template.declines: Report coverage separately; safe decline is not an answer success.

fallback.unknown_evidence: Abstain or require adjudication; never count null, missing output, routing alone or provider failures as factual correctness.

all_paths.abstentions: Report correct abstentions and avoidable abstentions separately; answerable-case denominator includes avoidable abstentions and failures.

live_run_contract.harness: server/scripts/benchmark_country_planner.py; extend this harness, do not introduce a parallel scorer
live_run_contract.opt_in: Explicit live flag plus approved model-specific pricing and total cost cap; validate-only/offline remains key-free.
live_run_contract.budget_enforcement: The harness reserves conservative approved input-ceiling plus explicit output/thinking bounds before every HTTP call, including failures/retries/repeats. One worker, at most 100 calls and USD1. Unknown prices/bounds reject before a call; incomplete usage prevents approval. Only actual interpretation/generation calls are charged; no retrieval/embedding provider is called by the immutable-context adapter.
live_run_contract.isolation: Reuse private_database_snapshot and isolate_plan_cache; immutable private fact backup and frozen pre-retrieved context JSON. The adapter executes the actual fallback prompt and answer stage without importing gameplay, Qdrant, application caches or history repositories. Live embedding/vector retrieval quality is explicitly outside this conditional answer-stage score. Persist only isolated evidence reports.

TARGET_NAME.text: Frozen retrieved text; empty string explicitly records no fragments

EXACT_MODEL_ID.max_input_tokens: approved integer conservative UTF-8 request bound plus 4096 envelope headroom

assessment_contract.dimensions: Keep route correctness, interpretation correctness, factual correctness, evaluator correctness and evidence grounding separate; overlapping causes need separate fields, not a forced single causal label. Missing predicates are advisory unless a wrong answer and a correct independently reviewed gold execution support the dropped-predicate cause. Gold/actual disagreement with reviewed truth alone remains an unadjudicated fact-or-evaluator disagreement. Per-target causal_reviews require reviewed=true, nonempty evidence and observed_artifact_sha256 matching the emitted assessment_artifact_sha256; a static case label cannot certify new provider explanations.
assessment_contract.reviewed_answers: Compare actual per-target outputs with expected_answers before comparing gold-plan denotations. Executing actual and gold plans against one bad snapshot cannot establish factual correctness.
assessment_contract.fallback_routing: A fallback plan does not execute an answer model; report answer correctness and execution as unassessed until the fallback stage runs.
assessment_contract.generic_cache_identity: Include mode, normalized whole question, PLANNER_VERSION, selected model, and semantic prompt/config identity (shared rules, mode notes, supported relations, entity bindings and generation settings). A change must miss even if the question/model/global version is unchanged. No target-specific answer caching.

cases.question: Is it in Europe?
cases.review_basis: Physical continent membership; independently familiar positive and negative controls.
cases.notes: Safe template if accepted; a model plan must preserve the same proposition.

cases.question: Czy leży w Europie?
cases.review_basis: Same physical-continent convention as English counterpart.
cases.notes: Polish template may safely decline; this is not permission to answer a changed predicate.

cases.question: Does it not share a land border with Germany?
cases.review_basis: Known land adjacency, negated over the entire proposition.
cases.notes: A positive border plan is an interpretation error, not merely a bad fact.

cases.question: Does it have more than 1 million people but fewer than 10 million people?
cases.review_basis: Hand calculation from the explicitly frozen snapshot; not a current population estimate.
cases.notes: Dropping the upper bound falsely accepts Poland and Sweden.

cases.question: Czy ma ponad milion mieszkańców, ale mniej niż dziesięć milionów?
cases.review_basis: Same snapshot arithmetic, both strict bounds retained.
cases.notes: Keep the two languages together to prevent paraphrase leakage.

cases.question: Does it not border Antzzq?
cases.review_basis: Antzzq cannot be resolved to a known country; negation does not make it true.
cases.notes: Clarification is an appropriate abstention, not false.

cases.question: Czy jest państwem wyspiarskim i leży w Europie?
cases.review_basis: Island-country classification AND physical Europe membership.
cases.notes: Japan separates an island-only interpretation from the whole proposition.

cases.question: Is it in Europe or Asia, but not Africa?
cases.review_basis: (Europe OR Asia) AND NOT Africa; physical continent lists, not cultural regions.
cases.notes: A required-atom list alone cannot certify boolean scope.

cases.question: Does any of its territory lie in the Southern Hemisphere?
cases.review_basis: Explicit any-territory convention including Ilhéu das Rolas; not representative-point latitude. Prior audit records this semantic boundary; citations remain unknown here.
cases.notes: Convention is explicit; never silently change to capital or centroid.

cases.question: Was it a NATO member on 31 December 1989?
cases.review_basis: Germany refers to the Federal Republic continuity convention; Poland joined after 1989 and Japan is not a member. External citation review still required before release approval.
cases.notes: Current membership cannot answer the historical date. Fallback routing alone earns no answer credit.

cases.question: Czy 31 grudnia 1989 należało do NATO?
cases.review_basis: Same historical convention as English counterpart; citation not fabricated.
cases.notes: The entire temporal qualifier must survive interpretation.

cases.question: Does red cover at least one third of its flag?
cases.review_basis: Poland has equal horizontal white/red halves. Japan's precise red-area share is deliberately unreviewed, so null means unadjudicated, not a certified factual abstention.
cases.notes: Do not substitute red presence for area. Unreviewed targets cannot approve a release.

cases.question: Czy jest bogatym krajem?
cases.review_basis: No wealth measure, year, comparison set or threshold is specified.
cases.notes: Clarify rather than invent a GDP threshold; no boolean fact gold exists.
